sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State Of Up And 3 Others
Counsel for Applicant :- Shailendra Kumar Tripathi
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.
1.
Sri Santosh Nigam, learned AGA apprised the Court that on 19.2.2024 notice has been served to the informant.
Despite service of notice, none appeared on behalf of the informant.

2. Heard Sri Shailendra Kumar Tripathi, learned counsel for the applicant and Sri Santosh Nigam,
learned AGA-I for the State-respondent.
3.

The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No.
223 of 2023, under Sections 363, 366, 323, 376 IPC and 506 IPC and 3/4 POCSO Act, Police Station Thathiya, District Kannauj, during pendency of the trial in the court below.

4. Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that this is second bail application filed on behalf of the applicant and his first bail application was dismissed on merit by this Court on 20.9.2023 and he is pressing the instant second bail application on the ground that after rejection of the first bail Sachin Dixit @ Golu vs State Of Up And 3 Others on 16 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/183315617/
1 application of the applicant when victim appeared before the trial court then she was declared hostile as she did not support the prosecution and her statement has been annexed alongwith the instant bail application.
5.

entities.text: Sachin Dixit @ Golu vs State Of Up And 3 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
He further submitted that applicant is having no previous criminal history and in the present matter, he is in jail since 14.7.2023.
6.

Per contra, learned AGA opposed the prayer for bail but could not dispute the fact that when victim appeared before the trial court as PW-1 then she did not support the prosecution case and has been declared hostile.
7. I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.
8. However, this is second bail application filed on behalf of the applicant and his first bail application was dismissed on merit vide order dated 20.9.2023 but

it appears that after rejection of the first bail application when on 3.1.2024, victim appeared before the court concerned as PW-1 then she did not support the prosecution and she has been declared hostile.
Further, applicant is having no previous criminal history and in the present matter, applicant is in jail since July, 2023.

9. Therefore, considering the facts and circumstances of the case, discussed above, in my view,
applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
10. Accordingly, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the instant bail application is allowed.

11. Let the applicant- Sachin Dixit @ Golu, be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the dates fixed, unless his personal presence is exempted.
(ii) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly, make inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
(iii) The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal and anti-social activity.
12. In case of breach of any of the above condition, the prosecution will be at liberty to move an application before this Court for cancellation of the bail of the applicant.
13.

It is clarified that the observations made herein are limited to the facts brought in by the parties pertaining to the disposal of bail application and the said observations shall have no bearing on the merits of the case during trial.
